paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better
caption: : Gemini-Pro
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the informativeness of different methods, specifically 0-CoT and CoRe, across a range of input lengths. The x-axis is labeled "Input Length" and displays a linear scale ranging from 0 to 4, with tick marks spaced by 1. The y-axis, labeled "Informativeness," is also linear, extending from approximately 0.910 to 0.960, with tick marks spaced by 0.010. A blue dashed line represents the 0-CoT method, starting at approximately 0.958 at x=0 and decreasing to approximately 0.912 at x=3.5. A orange solid line represents the CoRe method, beginning at approximately 0.952 at x=0 and declining to approximately 0.910 at x=3.5.
